svg.text: Source nearest-pad pitch: Prime 1.27 mm; extension 1.27 mm. Depicted pitch: 20 mm.
Connect same numbered contacts; pin numbers govern continuity, not a guessed ribbon stripe.
Source: two-row native solder-pad centres. Depiction: one column, 20 mm pitch; symbols are electrical, not mating faces.
Source JP1 bridged; low-current 24V DC resistive bench example only; no mains or inductive load.
Host3V3 supplies TPSI3050 VDDP pin3; PB1→R1 100R→EN pin1, R2 10k pulls EN to hostGND.
TPSI3050 generated VDDH/VDDM and VDRV drive both gates via10R; SW_COM is isolated from hostGND.
J2.1 SW_A→F1→Q1 drain; Q1/Q2 share source SW_COM; Q2 drain→J2.2 SW_B.
Gate-to-source100k resistors and source-populated SMDJ33CA across switched path remain retained.
Set isolated bench supply to24.0V, current limit≤50mA; use1kΩ±1%,≥1W resistor rated at actual bench ambient.
Nominal closed-loop current24mA, resistor dissipation0.576W are calculations, not measurements or board-current ratings.
PB1 HIGH requests ON, LOW requests OFF. Reset/power-off state and installed firmware/runtime are not qualified.
J2 is the isolated switched load path. Host J1.2/4–9 source NC; no load return tied to host GND.
Physical connector orientation / fitted cable and actual page-viewer review remain OPEN. No hardware qualification.

svg.text: Complete floating load loop; no host-ground bond.
Resistor rating must cover actual bench ambient.
J2 native source pitch10.00mm; depicted120mm. Fitted terminal orientation and cable specification remain OPEN.
TPSI3050 generates isolated MOSFET gate drive. This is not a raw3V3 MOSFET-gate load claim.
No mains, inductive load, high-current/thermal/protection qualification or measured switching behavior claimed.
Actual viewer, fitted assembly/mating, matching P12 whole-board artwork and retained-art audit remain OPEN.
